newsitem.title: JAPAN: All Tokyo corn futures end sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: All Tokyo corn futures end sharply lower.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed sharply lower on Tuesday, as speculative selling orders emerged after the spot May contract's expiry, traders said.
The spot May contract expired late morning at 18,400 yen, down 610 yen from Monday's closing. The benchmark March 1998 contract ended down 220 yen at 16,380 yen.
Daily volume was estimated at 55,206 lots.
"The spot month's sharply lower expiry price triggered speculative selling in the afternoon," a brokerage trader said.

On CBOT Project A, the spot May corn contract was traded at $3.02-3/4 per bushel at 0745 GMT, down from $3.03-3/4 at Monday's close. Spot May CBOT soybean futures were traded at $8.31-1/2 per bushel on the overnight trading system, down from $8.33 at Monday's close.
